methodologyNotes: Roster covers 12 drawing/graphics tablets (pen tablets and pen displays), entry through professional, from Wacom, Huion, and XP-Pen. Each product independently re-verified 2026-06-20 against official manufacturer pages (wacom.com, estore.wacom.com, huion.com, store.huion.com, xp-pen.com) and reputable retailers/reviewers (B&H, Best Buy, Adorama, Quill, CG Channel, PetaPixel, Parka Blogs, Windows Central). priceUsd reflects a published US price for the exact named model/config; where only a transient flash-sale price existed it was replaced with the stable MSRP/street price. active_area_in is the pen's drawable area; for pen displays this equals the panel area. screen_resolution is null for screenless pen tablets. boolean true = feature present. Key adversarial fixes this pass: Intuos S tilt_support corrected to false (Pen 4K has no tilt); Intuos Pro PTH-660 restored to a real published price (the draft's 'replaced by PTK670' was fabricated — PTK670 is not a Wacom model and PTH-660 is still sold); Cintiq 22 active area corrected to the true 18.7 x 10.5 in panel; Cintiq 16 2025 active area filled in (13.6 x 8.5 in); Wacom One 12 price corrected to $299.95; H640P price corrected off an Amazon flash sale. accessedAt 2026-06-20.

products.name: Wacom Intuos S
products.priceNote: MSRP, wired USB version (CTL-4100); Bluetooth version CTL-4100WLK ~$99.95
products.provenance: CORRECTED: tilt_support true->false. The Wacom Intuos (CTL-4100) ships with the Wacom Pen 4K (LP-1100K) which provides 4096 pressure levels but NO tilt recognition — confirmed on Wacom's official Intuos product/spec page (tilt not listed) and across reviews; only the Intuos Pro line supports tilt. Active area 152 x 95 mm (6.0 x 3.7 in), 4 ExpressKeys, battery-free EMR pen, wired USB. MSRP $79.95 (wired) widely cited. Release 2018.

products.name: Wacom Intuos Pro Medium
products.priceNote: Still actively sold (Quill $379.99, Adorama, MacHollywood); original Wacom MSRP $379.95. Pro Pen 2 model.
products.provenance: CORRECTED: priceUsd null->379.99. The draft's claim that PTH-660 was 'replaced by PTK670' is FABRICATED — PTK670 is not a real Wacom Intuos Pro model number (Wacom uses PTH-prefixes; the 2025 Intuos Pro is still PTH-series). The PTH-660 remains actively sold: Quill lists it at $379.99 and it appears at Adorama, MacHollywood, Best Buy; original Wacom MSRP $379.95. Active area 224 x 148 mm (8.7 x 5.8 in), 8192 pressure (Pro Pen 2), +/-60 tilt, 8 ExpressKeys + Touch Ring, USB + Bluetooth, battery-free. Launched 2017.

products.name: Wacom One 12
products.provenance: CORRECTED: priceUsd 309.95->299.95. US price is $299.95 (Best Buy, Adorama, Connection, Wacom store). Launched 2023 (2023 Edition Wacom One). 11.6 in panel, active area 257 x 145 mm (10.1 x 5.7 in), 1920x1080, 4096 pressure, 60 deg tilt, battery-free EMR Standard Pen, two USB-C ports (DP Alt Mode), no hardware ExpressKeys.

products.name: Wacom Cintiq 16 (2025)
products.provenance: CORRECTED: active_area_in null->'13.6 x 8.5 in' (confirmed via B&H DTK168K0A listing and sevenpens spec notes for the 16in 16:10 panel). Model DTK168K0A launched mid-July 2025, replacing the 2019 DTK-1660. Resolution 2560x1600, Pro Pen 3 (ACP-500) with 8192 pressure + 60 deg tilt, battery-free EMR, USB-C + HDMI. MSRP $699.95 confirmed (CG Channel, B&H). No hardware ExpressKeys.

products.name: Wacom Cintiq 22
products.priceNote: Wacom Outlet/eStore $999.95; Best Buy clearance $974.99; original MSRP $1,199.99
products.provenance: CORRECTED: active_area_in '13.6 x 7.6 in'->'18.7 x 10.5 in'. For a pen display the active area equals the panel area = 476 x 268 mm = 18.7 x 10.5 in (confirmed via B&H, techhypermart, e-catalog specs); the draft's 13.6 x 7.6 figure was an erroneous internal 'drawable area' invention. 21.5 in display, 1920x1080, 8192 pressure (Pro Pen 2), +/-60 tilt, battery-free, no hardware ExpressKeys, HDMI+USB-A 3-in-1 cable. Price $999.95 (Wacom Outlet/eStore), Best Buy clearance $974.99; original MSRP ~$1,199.99. Launched 2019.
